title: DMAP-AI Knowledge Center
description: Scientific articles, tutorials, and reference documentation for drought monitoring, drought indices, climate datasets, wavelet analysis, and AI-assisted drought interpretation.

categories.title: Drought Basics
categories.description: Learn the fundamental concepts of drought, including its causes, development, impacts, and classification.

categories.title: Drought Indices
categories.description: Understand SPI, SPEI, PDSI, EDDI, and other commonly used drought indices.

categories.title: Climate Data
categories.description: Explore precipitation, temperature, evapotranspiration, and climate datasets used for drought monitoring.

categories.title: Analysis Methods
categories.description: Scientific methods including wavelet analysis, probability distributions, trend analysis, and drought event detection.

categories.title: AI Interpretation
categories.description: Learn how AI and structured metadata improve drought interpretation and reporting.

articles.title: What is Drought?
articles.summary: Learn what drought is, why it occurs, how it develops, and why accurate monitoring is important.

articles.title: Types of Drought
articles.summary: Understand meteorological, agricultural, hydrological, and socioeconomic drought.

articles.title: Meteorological Drought
articles.summary: Learn how precipitation deficits initiate drought and how meteorological drought is measured.

articles.title: Agricultural Drought
articles.summary: Discover how soil moisture deficits affect crop growth, irrigation, and food production.

articles.title: Hydrological Drought
articles.summary: Understand how drought influences rivers, reservoirs, lakes, and groundwater.
